key_points: Layer 1: Sovereign Cloud infrastructure (hybrid/neo-cloud, high-performance GPUs)

articles.title: The Efficiency Dividend: Using Agentic AI to Turn Operational Debt into Market Share
articles.summary: Defines operational debt as manual workarounds, data silos and people-bridged processes; argues agentic AI converts maintenance time into innovation capacity.

Approach: analyze debt, integrate personalized agents (Claude, GPT-4o, internal LLM chains), redirect saved time to growth
